						add_dynamic_modifier = {
							modifier = wif_large_polish_resistance_quintupled
							days = 180
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_mech_early_100 value = 1 }
					# Remove demilitarization from THIS state only, after 60 days
					FROM = {
						state_event = { id = wif_gen.31 days = 60 }
					}
					country_event = { id = wif_gen.30 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_gen_category = {
	wif_gen_roundup = {
		icon = generic_prepare_civil_war
		cost = 25
		days_re_enable = 60
		visible = { has_completed_focus = wif_gen_lapanka NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_gen_cheap_roundup } }
		available = { has_manpower > 15000 }
		complete_effect = {
			add_manpower = -15000
			custom_effect_tooltip = wif_gen_roundup_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } GER = { add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_gen_roundup_ger_idea days = 90 } } }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gen_ak = 3 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_gen_ak min = 15 max = 100 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 3 }
	}
	wif_gen_roundup_cheap = {
		icon = generic_prepare_civil_war
		cost = 15
		days_re_enable = 60
		visible = { has_completed_focus = wif_gen_lapanka has_country_flag = wif_gen_cheap_roundup }
		available = { has_manpower > 15000 }
		complete_effect = {
			add_manpower = -15000
			custom_effect_tooltip = wif_gen_roundup_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } GER = { add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_gen_roundup_ger_idea days = 90 } } }
				add_to_variable = { wif_gen_ak = 3 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_gen_ak min = 15 max = 100 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 3 }
	}
	wif_gen_forest_sweep = {
		icon = generic_police_action
		cost = 25
		days_remove = 30
		days_re_enable = 30
		visible = { has_completed_focus = wif_gen_anti_partisan }
		available = { has_manpower > 1999 }
		complete_effect = { add_manpower = -2000 custom_effect_tooltip = wif_gen_sweep_tt }
		remove_effect = {
			random_list = {
				50 = { subtract_from_variable = { wif_gen_ak = 5 } }
				50 = { subtract_from_variable = { wif_gen_ak = 10 } }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_gen_never_surrenders } subtract_from_variable = { wif_gen_ak = 3 } }
			clamp_variable = { var = wif_gen_ak min = 15 max = 100 }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 modifier = { factor = 3 check_variable = { wif_gen_ak > 50 } } }
	}
}
